readiness.description: Small public output/workflow checks used by OSS Readiness; no model training.
readiness.limits: Pure output/workflow checks. Does not perform the eight CUDA training cases or benchmark inference.

public-connectors.description: Existing Docker public reader suites, with generated/fake data and no cloud credentials.
public-connectors.limits: Builds/downloads public container dependencies and uses Docker. Doctor checks executable presence, not Docker daemon access, Buildx or available image architectures.

diskgraph-rust.description: Existing locked Rust workspace tests on the author's own machine.
diskgraph-rust.limits: Compiles native code and may download Cargo dependencies. Needs the repository toolchain and native prerequisites; this is correctness coverage, not a performance comparison.

commerce-generate-smoke.description: Generate the existing small public commerce fixture with one worker.
commerce-generate-smoke.limits: Small fixture generation only; excludes generation from any later benchmark. Install the generator's requirements in a separate environment. Budget is a free-space preflight, not a filesystem quota.

commerce-verify-smoke.description: Verify generated commerce hashes, row counts and schemas with the existing verifier.
commerce-verify-smoke.limits: Checks generated data, not sampling equivalence or model learning quality.

commerce-snapshot-smoke.description: Run the existing commerce workflow's snapshot stage against local smoke data.
commerce-snapshot-smoke.limits: Snapshot-only smoke; requires installed matching in-tree Engine and DiskGraph. Does not run training, GPU inference, or the 50B reference workload. Use local SSD scratch.

temporal-ranges-smoke.description: Small-degree mode of the existing oracle-checked paired DiskGraph temporal-range harness.
temporal-ranges-smoke.limits: Requires two separately built diskgraph package directories with different native-library hashes. Pins one available CPU; warm-cache query measurements only. Cannot establish GPU, cold-cache, or end-to-end training performance.
